purpose: Replicate the frozen Luna Agent comparison matrix with the base model switched to gpt-5.6-sol. Only the model changes. Each condition runs from a replay tree whose pinned inputs are byte-identical to the Luna series manifest of that condition.
model_call_settings: identical to the Luna series: OpenAI-compatible chat.completions through the same local router; no temperature, seed or reasoning_effort parameter is sent (none was sent in any Luna series), so sampling is the endpoint default and stochasticity comes from independent calls

replicate_design.replicate_definition: one independent execution of every condition below; conditions are interleaved inside a replicate so condition is not confounded with wall-clock time
replicate_design.final_n_rule: the scientific dataset is every replicate executed under this protocol; the reported N for a condition is its number of completed runs that pass integrity checks, and model-output-invalid runs stay in the denominator; technical (API/infrastructure) failures are recorded with technical_failure = true, retained, excluded from the scientific denominator and never silently replaced

conditions.declaration_runner_note: scripts/run_agent_v4_series.py was uncommitted at the declared commit 9937398 and was committed with this series in 3e1df9c; it is orchestration only and not a pinned input.

conditions.role: rule-layer ablation: deterministic VOI score withheld
conditions.declaration_runner_note: the series runner at the declared commit 71bf7d9 predates --withhold-voi-scores; the flag-bearing orchestration-only runner is taken from 38d6f63, which also supplies the pinned per-run script bytes.
--rule-order was uncommitted at the declared commit 38d6f63 and was committed with the order arm in 3baee74; orchestration only, not a pinned input.

architecture ablation: chemistry gate advice-only (processing-window condition)

It is not a pinned input.

support_files.note: imported by the pinned Condition-B runner; uncommitted at 4421cb2; only one version exists in history

conditions.role: Full PUR Agent with enforced chemistry gate (processing-window condition)

not_run.reason: described as a supplementary control in docs/AGENT_BASELINE_PROTOCOL.md, but no agent context was ever frozen for the 73-node lattice and no Luna series exists; running it would create a new, unregistered condition

replay_tree_rule: Each condition runs from a detached git worktree at the Luna series' declared commit. Every file pinned in that Luna series manifest is overwritten with the historical bytes whose sha256 equals the pin (some pins are LF bytes because the Luna runs used an LF working copy). Before any model call the tree must reproduce every pinned hash, the candidate-set and evidence-state hashes, and, for V5, the Luna pre-enforcement payload hash.
frozen_and_untouched: all prompts, configs, scoring code and tools in the main working tree
metrics: Luna-defined metrics recomputed for both models by scripts/crossmodel/summarize_crossmodel.py, which must first reproduce the published Luna aggregates from the Luna records

amendments.change: An HTTP-200 response with empty message content ("model returned empty content") is classified as technical_failure = true (category empty_model_content): retained, not re-run, excluded from the scientific denominator. Malformed or schema-violating JSON remains a model-output failure (invalid) inside the denominator.
amendments.basis: two consecutive empty responses at 06:00Z (Judge stage, then an 8 s Planner call on a ~6k-token prompt) while a probe call seconds later returned normally; no empty response occurs in any Luna record. The runner does not record finish_reason, so the cause cannot be attributed to the model.
amendments.sensitivity: cumulative_summary.json also reports final-decision counts with empty_model_content runs counted as invalid.

amendments.change: orchestration only: (a) --resume-batch completes the unattempted (replicate, condition) pairs of the last batch; an attempted pair is never run again; (b) a one-token quota probe precedes every run and, on a router usage limit, the driver sleeps until the reported reset so quota exhaustion cannot consume a replicate slot. No prompt, input, tool, scoring or classification rule changes.
